ME_3.subject: Programming in Python Lab

courseOutcomes.description: Apply basic building blocks of python programming.
Develop Python programs using control structures, functions, and data structures to solve real-world problems.
Implement basics concepts of object-oriented programming using Python programs.
Design and develop interactive graphical user interfaces (GUIs) using Python GUI libraries to create applications and simple games

modules.title: Module 1: Introduction
topics: Introduction to importance of IDEs like Spyder (Anaconda)/PyCharm for professional programming
Explore Python shell as a calculator and for inputting Python expressions directly
Operators in Python: comparison, arithmetic, logical, Boolean, bitwise, assignment
Python: numbers, list, tuple, strings, set, dictionary

modules.title: Module 2: Basic Construct
topics: if-else, for loop, while loop, break, pass, continue
Creating Functions, functions with arguments, returning values from functions
Lambda expressions, recursion, global and local variables
Importing other modules/packages and using their functions
Creating random numbers/random-choice to create programs for simple guessing games like Rock–Paper–Scissors
Problem solving using dictionary as look-up table

modules.title: Module 3: Object Oriented Programming
topics: Basics of Object-oriented programming: Class and Object
Defining variables and functions inside class
Creating objects, Inheritance, Multiple and Multi Level Inheritance, Function over-riding
The concept of composing objects of a different class in an object, problems on object composition

modules.title: Module 4: GUI creation in Python (Basic Concept)
topics: GUI creation using Python's de-facto GUI package like tkinter or alternative packages like: wxPython, PyQt (PySide), Pygame, Pyglet, and PyGTK
Creating labels, buttons, entry (textbox), combobox, checkbutton, radiobutton, scrolledText (textarea), spinbox, progressbar, menubar, filedialog, tabs etc.
Creating GUI simple games like Tic-Tac-Toe

ME_3.subject: Mechanics of Materials Lab

courseOutcomes.description: Compute elongation, maximum stress, breaking stress, % age of reduction of area of the given specimen by using Universal Testing Machine.
Compute the Modulus of Rigidity, Breaking Torque and Ultimate Shear Stress of a mild steel specimen by conducting Torsion Test.
Compute the shear force and bending moment at any section of the simply supported beam.
Compute the deflection and bending stress of simply supported subjected to concentrated load at the center.
Verify the Euler buckling equation for steel columns of various lengths subjected to different end conditions.

experiments: Torsion Test: To determine Modulus of Rigidity (C), Breaking Torque (T) and Ultimate Shear Stress (τ) of a mild steel specimen by conducting Torsion Test.
Tension Test: To determine Elongation, Maximum stress, Breaking stress, % age of reduction of area of the given specimen.
Shearing Force and Bending Moment: To determine the shear force and bending moment at any section of the simply supported beam
Deflection of Beams: To determine the deflection and bending stress of simply supported subjected to concentrated load at the center.
Buckling of Columns: To verify the Euler buckling equation for steel columns of various lengths subjected to different end conditions.
textbooks: A Textbook of Strength of Materials: R. K. Bansal, Laxmi Publication (P) Ltd., 6th edition 2018
Fundamentals of Strength of Materials: Debabrata Nag and Abhijit Chanda, Wiley India Pvt Ltd. 2nd edition 2010.
